summary: Master the art of grant writing with our specialized training course for NGOs. Equip yourself with the tools to successfully attract funding and support.
lede: NGO grant proposal writing turns project ideas into clear applications that address donor requirements. For NGO program and project managers, grant officers, finance and results staff, and organizational leaders, this course covers interpreting funding calls, shaping project designs and logical frameworks, writing persuasive narratives, and linking realistic budgets to activities and results.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals engaged in proposal development and donor funding processes within NGOs.
audience: Executive directors and senior managers of NGOs
Partnership and business development staff in international
modules: Understanding the Funding Landscape and Donor Expectations
From Needs Assessment to Fundable Project Idea
Project Design, Theory of Change, and Logframe Basics
Developing Realistic and Donor Friendly Grant Budgets
Integrating M&E and Learning into Grant Proposals
Compliance, Eligibility, and Risk Management in Grant Writing
Reviewing, Editing, and Packaging Winning Proposals
Managing Donor Relationships Before and After Submission
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of NGO operations and previous experience in project management or proposal development. Familiarity with the project lifecycle and basic budgeting is recommended.
